projectDescription: A collection of C++, CUDA, and SQL projects built by Alexander Dela Cruz, covering GPU-accelerated parallel computing, relational database design, algorithm problem-solving, and real-time search implementations.
keyFeatures: CUDA GPU parallel programming: element-wise array multiplication, work scheduling strategies, and radix-2 FFT
N-body gravitational simulation with shared memory optimization achieving massive speedups over CPU baseline
MySQL relational database modeling a 9-floor hospital with patients, staff subtypes, treatments, and billing
C++ solutions to LeetCode and UVA Online Judge problems covering greedy, hash sets, DFS, and more
Real-time terminal dictionary search using prefix matching with highlighted output and character-by-character input
publicApiSurface: CUDA kernels: matrixProduct (Sol1/Sol2/Sol3), radix2FFT, bodyForce (GPU shared memory version)
CPU N-body baseline: bodyForce() with softened inverse-square gravity + collision detection
MySQL tables: patient, staff, doctor, nurse, manager, billing, treatment, treatment_staff
SQL queries: staff by pay rate, costly treatments, doctor-patient pairs, staff per patient, daily pay calculation
C++ functions: partialMatch(json, string), partialMatch(vector<string>, string), printHighlightedSubstr()
LeetCode solutions: reverseInt, isPalindrome, canJump, mySqrt, isPalindromeStr, longestConsecutive, topKFrequent, floodFill, numIslands
